blurb: Westside Recreation offers a variety of boat rentals at Lake Pleasant, including pontoons, speedboats, double deckers, luxury boats, and wakeboard surf boats. They also provide captained party boats for large groups and RV rentals. Boats come fully equipped with amenities like Bluetooth sound systems, shade, slides, and safety gear.
